## Added

- **Risk-based code review.** Post-Apply code review is now driven by risk triggers rather than running unconditionally on every change. Configure with `readyset.review.mode: auto | always | never` (default `auto`) or `--review auto|always|never`.
- **Review trigger evaluator.** In `auto` mode, review fires only when a risk trigger is met: unjustified scope drift, evidence conflicts, lack of command-backed verification notes, diff exceeding size thresholds (`maxLines` default 150, `maxFiles` default 5), or changes to sensitive paths (security, auth, migrations, configs).
- **`--review <change-id>` on demand.** Run a targeted code-review pass on any existing, unarchived change regardless of whether triggers fired.
- **Open decisions & assumptions surfacing.** Planning artifacts now explicitly capture open decisions and assumptions with recommended paths. The review gate presents unresolved decisions with an interactive `[O]` Resolve CTA.
- **Single bounded review-fix turn.** Blocking findings in `REVIEW.md` trigger at most one fix turn on the apply phase model to address the issues before archiving.
- **Safe scope reconciliation.** Protects pre-existing dirty files and active WIP by snapshotting files before reconciliation and guaranteeing byte-identical restoration if violated.
- **Stay-in-repo rule and tripwire.** Enforces repository containment across all phases, warning on out-of-tree filesystem searches.
- **Narrow verification retry prompt.** Replaces generic re-application when only verification notes are missing, saving wall-clock time and preventing implementation loops.

## Changed

- **Diff-first code review.** Code review prompts now focus first on the git diff and changed files rather than scanning the entire codebase.
- **Honest review skip stubs.** When review is skipped, `REVIEW.md` records an informative audit stub listing all evaluated triggers and observed values.
- **Bugfix doc boundaries & negative grounding.** Bugfixes and refactors strictly exclude unnecessary documentation updates (`README.md`, docs) from scope contracts. Negative statements avoid nonexistent file extensions (e.g. "no changelog entry" instead of "no CHANGELOG.md") to ensure clean plan grounding.

## Fixed

- **Scope contract false positives.** Repaired doc mentions and bullet open decision parsing; removed false positive outside-repo hits on API route strings.
- **Explicit `--lane` picker support.** Fast-lane brainstorms are now cleanly recognized and listed in the interactive picker when `--lane fast` or `--lane full` is specified.
- **Ask tool fallback.** Seamless fallback to plain chat questions when `readyset_ask` is unavailable in headless/RPC mode, eliminating tool-discovery loops.

## Install / Update

```
npx readyset-flow install
npx readyset-flow update
```
or with `bunx` in place of `npx`.

The extension module is referenced in place, so updating the package is enough — no re-install needed.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fresp/readyset-flow/compare/0.14.0...v0.15.0
